newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Asahimas to set up firm in Singapore.
newsitem.headline: Asahimas to set up firm in Singapore.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Asahimas Flat Glass Co. Ltd said it secured shareholder approval on Tuesday to set up a trading company in Singapore.

"At an extraordinary general meeting this afternoon, Asahimas received approval from shareholders to set up the 50-50 joint venture which will have a paid-up capital of S$200,000," Asahimas said in a statement.
It said the new firm called Glavermas Mirror Pte Ltd will be equally owned by Asahimas and Belgian glass manufacturer Glaverbel.
It said Glavermas, to be incorporated in Singapore, will act as Asahimas's sole marketing agent for Asia (excluding Indonesia, Middle East and Japan) and Australia for all of its mirror products.
Asahimas, a joint venture between Indonesian conglomerate the Rodamas Group and Japan's Asahi Glass Company Ltd is Southeast Asia's largest flat glass manufacturer.
